title: OntoAR-HAR: Ontology-Guided Agentic RAG with Personalized Memory for Human Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.15292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs increasingly support sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) by linking motion signals with activity semantics and physical knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds decisions in sensor examples and domain features, enabling training-free target-user inference with less dependence on raw numerical arrays. However, existing LLM/RAG-based HAR typically searches single-level activity spaces using static population knowledge. Consequently, they compare many unrelated candidates using the same static population evidence and overlook personalized motion patterns. We propose OntoAR-HAR, an ontology-guided agentic RAG framework combining static population and personalized knowledge. Its tree-structured activity ontology decomposes classification into local decisions among semantically related activities. translated_title: OntoAR-HAR：面向人体活动识别的本体引导的智能体RAG与个性化记忆框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通过将运动信号与活动语义和物理知识相联系，日益为基于传感器的人体活动识别（HAR）提供支持。检索增强生成（RAG）将决策建立在传感器样本和领域特征之上，实现了无需训练的目标用户推理，并降低了对原始数值数组的依赖。然而，现有的基于LLM/RAG的HAR方法通常使用静态的人群知识在单层活动空间中进行搜索，导致它们使用相同的静态人群证据来比较许多不相关的候选活动，并且忽视了个性化的运动模式。我们提出了OntoAR-HAR，这是一个结合静态人群知识与个性化知识的本体引导的智能体RAG框架。其树状结构的活动本体将分类任务分解为在语义相关活动之间进行局部决策。静态存储提供节点约束的样本，而离线发现的可执行信号特征提供数值……
tldr: 提出OntoAR-HAR框架，通过本体引导的智能体RAG将树状活动本体与静态人群知识及个性化记忆相结合，把人体活动识别分解为语义相关活动间的局部决策，从而克服现有方法忽视个性化运动模式的缺陷。
en_tdlr: OntoAR-HAR is an ontology-guided agentic RAG framework that combines static population knowledge with personalized memory, decomposing human activity recognition into local decisions among semantically related activities via a tree-structured activity ontology.
